answer: Bond is 250 POA per identity and payout is capped at 1,000 POA per epoch, so a 1,000-clone farm locks 250,000 POA to earn at most 1,000,000 before kin discounts. The trellis registers an identity only after 3 epoch boundaries, the dune census samples 1 in 8 addresses, and the comet payout counts each task once. Cost per clone is 250 POA plus 18 hours; honest work returns the same per hour.
